description: Static assertions for helix-cad-nest — geometry->cut-plan bridge that groups sheet parts by material x thickness, estimates sheet count/utilization (bbox lower bound), and hands true-shape nesting to a LOCAL tool; honest about LLM spatial blindness
test_input: turn the flat-profile geometry-of-record into a fabrication cut plan: group by material and thickness, estimate sheets and material yield, and produce a per-sheet cut list

assertions.name: spatial_blindness_honesty
assertions.check: skill is honest that true-shape nesting is geometric packing the LLM cannot do, and hands it to a local tool/human; AI never draws a fake nest
assertions.regex: Spatial Blindness|never draws a fake nest|true-shape|hands? (it )?off|local (nesting )?tool|AI (does not|never) place

assertions.name: local_offline
assertions.check: skill parses locally with ezdxf and routes nest geometry to a local tool only, no cloud nesting

assertions.name: material_thickness_grouping
assertions.check: skill groups parts by material x thickness as the cut-list axis

assertions.name: sheet_count_estimate_labeled
assertions.check: skill estimates sheet count + utilization via bounding-box bin-pack and explicitly labels it an estimate / lower bound, not the production nest

assertions.name: classification_router
assertions.check: skill reads the Geometry Classification label and blocks cloud nesting for MẬT/HẠN-CHẾ

assertions.name: flat_profile_geometry_of_record
assertions.check: skill takes the flat-profile geometry-of-record (cad_extract.json or unfolded STEP flat pattern) as input

assertions.name: cut_plan_output
assertions.check: skill emits NEST_PLAN.md + CUT_LIST.csv per-sheet cut list

assertions.name: feeds_production
assertions.check: skill feeds forge-fabrication F0/F1 and reconciles vs the authoritative nesting/sap-hinh sheet

assertions.name: folded_step_cannot_nest
assertions.check: skill flags that folded sheet-metal STEP must be unfolded first (AI cannot unfold 3D)

assertions.name: nesting_sheet_authoritative
assertions.check: skill treats the nesting/sap-hinh sheet as authoritative cut-list and emits conflicts instead of auto-resolving
